THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS HEARING,
THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE N S SANJAY GOWDA  ORAL ORDER 1.
The wife is before this Court seeking transfer of M.C.No.10/2024 filed by the husband before the Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Hiriyur to the V Additional Family Court at Bengaluru.

entities.text: V Additional Family Court at Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. On 14.11.2024, notice of this petition was ordered and petitioner was permitted to take out notice on the counsel who appeared in the Trial Court.
Despite service of notice on the counsel, there is no appearance on behalf of the respondent.

The wife has filed this petition contending that she has already filed a petition for maintenance before V Additional Family Court at Bengaluru and thereafter the respondent has filed a petition seeking for restitution before the Hiriyur Court.

4. It is also stated by the wife that she has instituted a of proceeding under Section 498A of the IPC,
she had also failed a criminal complaint on the basis of which a criminal case has been registered in C.C.No.18630/2012 and the same is pending before the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court at Bengaluru.
5.

entities.text: Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court at Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: She also submits that she is a resident of Bengaluru and it would not be possible to travel to Hiriyur.
6. In view of the above M.C.No.10/2024 which is pending on the file of the Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Hiriyur is withdrawn and transferred to the file of the V Additional Family Court at Bengaluru.
